note: Cookie names Veyl can name with confidence. Entries with category cdn/authentication/payment/consent-management/fraud-prevention are treated as functional and never counted against a site.

cookies.name: _ga
cookies.summary: A two-year identifier that lets Google Analytics recognise this browser on return visits.

cookies.name: _ga_*
cookies.summary: Holds the Google Analytics 4 session state for this site.

cookies.name: _gid
cookies.summary: A 24-hour identifier used to count you as one visitor across the day.

cookies.name: _gat*
cookies.summary: Throttles how often data is sent to Google Analytics.

cookies.name: _gcl_*

cookies.name: IDE

cookies.name: test_cookie

cookies.name: _fbp

cookies.name: _fbc

cookies.name: fr
cookies.summary: Meta's encrypted advertising identifier.

cookies.name: _ttp
